classification.difficultyReason: Students read axis scales, select usable points, calculate signed rise over run and form an equation. Later graphs remove the initial c and m prompts; unequal axis scales and an intercept halfway between gridlines require careful coordinate interpretation rather than judging visual steepness.

content.prompt: Determine the equation of these lines.

spec.description: Unit grid, arrowed increasing line and marked points (0,1), (2,2).
spec.mathematics: y=x/2+1; x from -2 to 4, y from -2 to 4; grid step 1.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph is visible.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=1$. From $(0,1)$ to $(2,2)$, rise $=1$ and run $=2$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{1}{2}\\y&=\frac{x}{2}+1\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Unit grid with points (-2,0), (0,2) on an arrowed line.
spec.mathematics: y=x+2; x from -3 to 3, y from -3 to 4; grid step 1.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph is visible.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=2$. From $(-2,0)$ to $(0,2)$, rise $=2$ and run $=2$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac22=1\\y&=x+2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Unit grid and decreasing line with points (0,1), (1,-1).
spec.mathematics: y=-2x+1; x from -2 to 3, y from -2 to 3; grid step 1.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph is visible.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=1$. From $(0,1)$ to $(1,-1)$, rise $=-2$ and run $=1$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{-2}{1}=-2\\y&=-2x+1\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Grid in steps of 2 with points (0,2), (4,0).
spec.mathematics: y=-x/2+2; x from -8 to 8, y from -6 to 6; grid step 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph is visible.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=2$. From $(0,2)$ to $(4,0)$, rise $=-2$ and run $=4$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{-2}{4}=-\frac12\\y&=-\frac{x}{2}+2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Grid in steps of 3, line through the origin and marked point (3,3).
spec.mathematics: y=x; both axes from -9 to 9; grid step 3.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph is visible.

answer.worked:
The line passes through the origin, so $c=0$. From $(0,0)$ to $(3,3)$, rise $=3$ and run $=3$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac33=1\\y&=x\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Grid in steps of 5 and points (0,10), (5,0). The y=-5 tick is unlabelled.
spec.mathematics: y=-2x+10; both axes from -15 to 15; grid step 5.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph is visible.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=10$. From $(0,10)$ to $(5,0)$, rise $=-10$ and run $=5$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{-10}{5}=-2\\y&=-2x+10\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Unit grid and points (0,-2), (1,0); y=-1 tick is unlabelled.
spec.mathematics: y=2x-2; both axes from -3 to 3; grid step 1.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph is visible.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=-2$. From $(0,-2)$ to $(1,0)$, rise $=2$ and run $=1$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac21=2\\y&=2x-2\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Grid in steps of 2 and points (-6,0), (0,-4).
spec.mathematics: y=-2x/3-4; x from -8 to 6, y from -6 to 6; grid step 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied graph is visible.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=-4$. From $(-6,0)$ to $(0,-4)$, rise $=-4$ and run $=6$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{-4}{6}=-\frac23\\y&=-\frac{2x}{3}-4\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Unit grid with points (0,-3), (2,-1) and dashed horizontal guide from (0,-1) to (2,-1).
spec.mathematics: y=x-3; x from -3 to 4, y from -4 to 3; grid step 1.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied coordinate guide remains visible.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=-3$. From $(0,-3)$ to $(2,-1)$, rise $=2$ and run $=2$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac22=1\\y&=x-3\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Orange line without marked points; horizontal grid step 2 and vertical grid step 1.
spec.mathematics: y=x/3-1; x from -4 to 8, y from -4 to 2.
spec.answerVisibility: No solution points or triangles are added.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=-1$. From $(0,-1)$ to $(6,1)$, rise $=2$ and run $=6$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac26=\frac13\\y&=\frac{x}{3}-1\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Decreasing orange line without marked points; both grid intervals are 4 units.
spec.mathematics: y=-4x+4; x from -8 to 16, y from -16 to 8; grid step 4.
spec.answerVisibility: No solution points or triangles are added.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept gives $c=4$. From $(0,4)$ to $(4,-12)$, rise $=-16$ and run $=4$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{-16}{4}=-4\\y&=-4x+4\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Increasing orange line without marked points; grid step 2; intercept halfway between -4 and -6.
spec.mathematics: y=5x/2-5; x from -4 to 8, y from -8 to 4; grid step 2.
spec.answerVisibility: No solution points or triangles are added.

answer.worked:
The $y$-intercept is halfway between $-4$ and $-6$, so $c=-5$. From $(0,-5)$ to $(2,0)$, rise $=5$ and run $=2$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac52\\y&=\frac{5x}{2}-5\end{aligned}$$
